implemented: One explicit owner/worker per shared host display and one data device per compatible seat (up to four), with public WaylandDataOwner and independently polled FileDropEndpoint handles; legacy receiver API retained.
Shared global admission: four workers and four surfaces, with display exclusivity against legacy/standalone receivers and checked owner/surface identities.
Single actual sync callback in flight, retired callback tombstones, endpoint identity/epoch matching, fair endpoint scheduling and non-renewing admission deadlines.

Parent close atomically cuts new admission/claim authority. An already accepted claim is preserved. Endpoint detach retires SDK routing/offers/pipe watcher/window lease before Detached acknowledgement; old terminal decisions cannot affect a replacement endpoint.

Admitted internal window/wake payloads, pipe buffers and resource-queue retirement remain off the caller and outside pool/header guards. Event/path metadata transferred by poll belongs to the consumer, which controls its destruction. Owner Closed requires certified SDK guest cleanup, actual worker join and display release. Uncertain SDK/TLS cleanup retains internal resources and Closing.
Protocol, worker-pool, real runtime FD/watcher retirement, public API boundary and public-consumer fixture coverage; existing tests/assertions retained.
Documented lifetime/reader safety contract, changelog, synthetic static Gallery page and generated 93-entry catalogue.

Two runtime API RED fixtures -> GREEN with the existing host protocol runtime: live FD/window retention before watcher retirement and honest uncertain cleanup after wake panic.

compatibility_limits: Unsafe attach/register require host reader coordination and actual live display/surface lifetime through owner Closed / endpoint Detached. Arc ownership alone is not proof. No guest raw display read/prepare/roundtrip or host-surface queue/userdata mutation.
This first owner scope classifies and discards Selection and does not bind Primary. It is not a functional clipboard backend and cannot replace the SDK clipboard yet.
Do not attach alongside an existing stock SDK data-device clipboard owner on the same display. RUNE uses its prior stock SDK and does not attach this new owner.

Protocol/runtime fixtures validate deterministic DnD behavior; native screenshots validate synthetic presentation only. A real shared owner + functional clipboard SDK host compositor test remains required.
No new dependencies. No official-client reverse engineering, imported session, live account traffic, credentials or clipboard contents.
